verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission concluded with a successful splashdown in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California, on April 10, 2026, at 8:07 p.m. EDT (5:07 p.m. PDT).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'splashed down in the Pacific Ocean, about 40 to 50 miles off the coast of San Diego... at 8:07 p.m. ET... April 10, 2026'; R2: 'off the coast of San Diego, California at 8:07 p.m. EDT'; R3: 'off the coast of San Diego at 8:07 p.m. EDT (5:07 p.m. PDT)'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm the exact location, date, and time of the splashdown.

verifications.claim: The Orion spacecraft brought the four-person crew back to Earth.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Orion capsule has splashed down... with the four Artemis II astronauts back on Earth'; R3: 'NASA’s Artemis II crew in their Orion spacecraft is back on Earth'
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm Orion carried the four-person crew back to Earth via splashdown.

verifications.claim: The four-person crew was recovered by the USS John P. Murtha.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'flown to the flight deck of USS John P. Murtha'; R3: 'flown to the USS John P. Murtha'; R4: 'flown to the USS John P. Murtha'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state the crew was recovered and transported to the USS John P. Murtha.

verifications.claim: The spacecraft is the Orion capsule named Integrity.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Orion capsule Integrity'; R3: 'Everything on board Integrity is in great shape'; R5: 'Integrity and her crew'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly name the Orion capsule as 'Integrity'.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission duration was 10 days.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '10-day trip to the moon'; R2: '10-day Artemis II mission'; R3: 'approximate 10-day mission'; R4: '10-day mission'
verifications.reasoning: Sources consistently describe it as a '10-day mission,' though precise duration is ~9 days 1 hour; commonly rounded and directly supported.

verifications.claim: The splashdown marked the first time humans returned from the vicinity of the Moon in over 50 years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'first human lunar mission in more than 50 years'; R6: 'last time humans landed on the moon was in 1972'; R8: 'first time since Apollo 17 in 1972'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm it as the first crewed lunar mission return since Apollo 17 (1972), over 50 years prior to 2026.

verifications.claim: The crew completed a "textbook" return after evaluating the spacecraft's systems.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: No references mention a 'textbook' return or specific post-evaluation description matching the claim.
